Quantum 1.38.0 was certified on 2026-09-25. It pins **nucleus v1.30.1**, **quark v1.15.0** and **orbit v1.18.0**, with 25 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.37.0: orbit goes from v1.16.0 to v1.18.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.30.1 and quark stays at v1.15.0. 4 sibling modules change version.
